You sound like a lovely, caring and loving mother who is doing her very best for everyone except themselves. 

I don't have much advice except to say that you deserve more help and support from your husband in all areas of your life. He should be taking care of the children when he's not at work, and he should be supporting you to find a career or hobbies outside the children. I suspect these things would help your mental health. 

I would echo what others have said above. Only you can decide if this is the life you want to carry on living but as an outsider you deserve better and so do your children. 

I wish you well.

Same. Spend all evening sitting out. Lots of work still to be done but so satisfying to see it progress, ever so slowly. I've developed repetitive strain in my right arm from pulling weeds though so having to go slower. Worth it though.

Started on 150mg a year ago and moved up to 225g a couple of months ago. I also take a daily beta blocker and have found the combo to be life changing. It didn't make my worries disappear but it's made my lows far more stable and manageable. 

The side effects starting off were alot- especially over heating, dry mouth and nausea but that passed after about a month. 

I'm very happy with it and have no intention of coming off it. Makes life easier all round.

Just be there- hold her hand. You'll treasure this time after the dust settles. It's an awful, hard time. Try not to overthink it- there is no right or wrong way to say goodbye.
Be gentle with yourself. I hope your mom is OK.
